scope: Disposable live validation of the existing companion scripts; existing workloads were not modified.

same_supervisor.destination: A separate disposable VKS cluster created for this test (one control plane, one worker).
checks: Ready Supervisor snapshot created by script.
Source VKS PVC and PV deleted by script without finalizer removal or reclaim-policy changes.
Supervisor PVC/PV UIDs and FCD preserved.
Destination claim Bound with original source PVC name.
Read-only destination reader on the new worker matched both source SHA-256 checksums.
same_supervisor.source_deletion_observation: One snapshot-admission deletion rejection and initial retry were logged before explicit source PV removal. No later retries for that PV appeared in the captured logs across source provisioner pods. This is a bounded observation, not a guarantee for other versions.

destination_registration.fixture: A separate, fresh 1Gi FCD created directly in the same demo vCenter with the namespace-assigned storage policy.
checks: Supervisor PV matched the FCD ID, capacity, filesystem, and claim UID.
VKS static PV/PVC Bound using the Supervisor PVC name as volumeHandle.
Writer initialized the blank filesystem and wrote a marker.
Separate read-only reader matched the marker checksum.
limitations: No cross-vCenter vMotion or helper-VM transport was exercised.
This fresh-disk fixture validates registration/adoption/mounting, not preservation of data moved across vCenters.

live_guards: Same-cluster source/destination rejected before storage changes.
Cross-script empty confirmation stopped after server dry-runs without creating objects.
Cross-script rerun rejected the existing registration before overwriting any object.

cleanup.method: UID-checked deletion of task-created objects and normal controller reclamation; no finalizers stripped.

limitations: Velero backup/restore and application restart were outside the companion scripts and were not tested. Test manifests and an independent local payload backup were retained instead.
Snapshot preservation must still be rehearsed for other CSI/finalizer/version combinations.
